title: PARLOMA – A Novel Human-Robot Interaction System for Deaf-Blind Remote Communication
authors: Ludovico Orlando Russo; Giuseppe Airò Farulla; Daniele Pianu; Alice Rita Salgarella; Marco Controzzi; Christian Cipriani; Calogero Maria Oddo; Carlo Geraci; Stefano Rosa; Marco Indaco

cap: Hardware abstraction; not negotiated user profile

title: Bidirectional Braille-speech Communication System for Deafblind Students
authors: Ana Paula Pérez-Aguirre; Iván Arturo Morales-Pérez; Jorge Allan Gómez-Mercado; Rodrigo Alberto Gutiérrez-Martínez; Iván Matehuala-Moran; Rubén Fuentes-Alvarez
